psychological_meaning: Navy Blue is often associated with depth, stability, and authority. It evokes feelings of trust, loyalty, and confidence. This color is also linked to intelligence, knowledge, and seriousness, making it a popular choice for institutions seeking to project an image of professionalism and reliability. It provides a sense of calm and order.

real_world_examples.title: US Navy Uniform
real_world_examples.description: The official uniform of the United States Navy uses a shade of navy blue, symbolizing authority and tradition.

real_world_examples.title: Corporate Logos
real_world_examples.description: Many corporate logos use navy blue to convey trustworthiness and professionalism.
